meta.notes: Two sources, kept apart. The programme contacts (medical, family support, legal, housing, family advocacy, EFMP, child care, emergency relief) were imported by scripts/import-installations.mjs from the official MilitaryINSTALLATIONS pages for this installation. The agencies Military OneSource does not publish per installation were left empty — no official installation website was resolved for it, and Military OneSource itself is copied from national.json. Every contact carries the URL of the page it was read from; nothing here was typed in, inferred, or generated. Where both sources published a number the MilitaryINSTALLATIONS value stands and the base site’s is recorded in that contact’s notes rather than discarded. Still empty here, because no source read published one: command-post, mental-health, chaplain, sarc, security-forces, finance, mpf, family-advocacy, efmp, equal-opportunity. Re-run either importer to refresh; the diff is the change.
